Bluetooth: qca: add WCN7860 support

Ideally, prior to downloading the Bluetooth firmware and NVM files,
it is necessary to initialize and configure the baud rate for
the Peripheral subsystem, followed by downloading the Peripheral
firmware and NVM, and finally, downloading the TME-L subsystem firmware.

However, in this initial support phase, simply waking up the SoC and
configuring the Peripheral subsystem's baud rate is sufficient to enable
Bluetooth functionality.

This chip requires this change currently to negate a firmware crash. Follows up on the QDSS support in the previous commit.

Signed-off-by: Gianni Spadoni <me@gio.blue>
Signed-off-by: map220v <map220v300@gmail.com>

wifi: ath12k: send QDSS config when CNSS_QDSS_CFG_MISS_V01 is disabled

When CNSS_QDSS_CFG_MISS_V01 is enabled, the WCN7860 crashes when initializing firmware.

At the moment, my best guess is that the AUX_UC is being sent when the firmware has already started initializing.
If CNSS_QDSS_CFG_MISS_V01 is disabled, the chip waits to receive the config before firmware init, giving us enough time to send the AUX_UC.

As it stands, ath12k doesn't support sending the QDSS config - this commit adds support for it.

arm64: dts: qcom: kaanapali: Add GPU cooling

Unlike the CPU, the GPU does not throttle its speed automatically when it
reaches high temperatures.

Set up GPU cooling by throttling the GPU speed
when reaching 105°C.

arm64: dts: qcom: Add GPU support for Kaanapali

Adreno 840 present in Kaanapali SoC is the second generation GPU in
A8x family. It is based on the new slice architecture with 3 slices,
higher GMEM/caches etc.

There is some re-arrangement in the reglist to properly cover maximum
register region. Other than this, the DT description is mostly similar
to the existing chipsets except the OPP tables.
